chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyas, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

It is not permissible to feed a single child in the expiation of an oath, but two children with one adult is permissible, and this does not contradict the first report, because the impermissibility of feeding a child applies only if he is alone; as for when he is mixed with adults, there is no objection to that.
ai.seo_question: Can children be included in the food expiation for breaking an oath?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi presents this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to resolve the apparent contradiction (*ikhtilaf*) between reports regarding the validity of feeding children in *kaffarat al-yamin*. The ruling distinguishes between isolating a child, which is insufficient due to their limited capacity to fulfill the expiation's intent, and mixing them with adults, which validates the act by ensuring the required quantity and quality of sustenance are met. This reflects the Shia juristic principle of prioritizing the substantive fulfillment of the obligation over rigid numerical constraints when the intent is preserved.
